name: Weave
long_description:
Weave builds AI to understand engineering work from prompt to production. We show how much faster AI is making your team, how that impacts quality, and what it's costing. 

Weave then takes that data to route all of your tasks to the most cost efficient model without compromising speed or quality.

Weave is used by over 500+ orgs from startups to public companies like Robinhood, Posthog and Telnyx.

launches.title: Weave: AI to quantify engineering work
launches.tagline: Engineering metrics for the AI era
launches.body:
tl;dr: Weave uses AI to measure software engineering work in the AI era.

It shows how much work is being done, how much is done by AI and where you can utilize AI tools to improve your engineering process.

### **The Problem**

Historically, it’s been impossible to measure engineering so leaders are left flying blind. Engineering teams rely on gut feel or shoddy metrics to try to get a handle on what’s going on and where to improve.

That's why we built Weave.

### The Solution

https://youtu.be/GkZv9-YZTKI

Weave uses AI to measure engineering work. We run LLMs and our own models on every PR and review, analyzing both output and quality. We integrate with all AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) and have PR level code attribution to determine what was written by AI, what wasn’t, and what should’ve been.

We summarize this data and insights in dashboards. Teams like Reducto, Superpower and Laurel use Weave to ship 16% more, just 2 months after using Weave.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/966b7f89-b6a1-4aa7-8fbc-4b6cd7bf4fb1)


### AI Usage

We show you who your top AI performers are (so they can share best practices), how the team stacks up against its competitors and the real financial return of your AI investments.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/57dfeddd-0c9f-49c1-afea-0454bad3f0ab)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/56c25bbf-a333-4bea-9938-93e639687d12)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/c2672d3e-b073-45d1-95d8-41578f1a829d)

### AI Insights

We keep you up to date with the best practices and tools used by the most forward-thinking AI teams.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/d438efd0-4a9b-41a2-a4ae-1d506e800595)

### Measuring Code Output

This isn't a line of code calculator, this is an actual estimate of our key metric, a Weave Hour: "How long would it take an experienced engineer to make this change?"

We can also tell you how much time each engineer is spending on code review and how helpful their reviews are:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/581a3928-2eb3-4e98-a0d4-e8ae64c6cd15)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/ede5f44c-ca77-4d4c-ab23-12d7c3c6df7f)

### Individual

See output across individuals to identify top performers, see how new hires are ramping and if anyone is blocked.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/65664616-047f-4ce7-829c-b40839f34d09)

### **Our Story**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/2077133/d1883e57-85cd-4616-a456-3370a1a0b664)

Adam’s background is in operations and sales. He led organizations of 100+ people and created an internal tool to measure performance and help individuals identify their weak spots. This is common practice in revenue teams and he wants to bring it to engineering.

Andrew was employee #1 at Causal. He saw firsthand how subjective engineering management is and how hard it is to scale a high-performing engineering team.

We met at Causal, where Adam was hired to run the sales and customer success function. We got to talking about the big difference between how our two departments worked, and the rest is history.

**Early Use Cases**

* Reducto, Superpower, and Posthog have used Weave to see increases in output correlated with AI usage (16% on average)
* A manager noticed that code review quality has the highest correlation to output. He reset code review standards and team output went up by 15%
* Smaller engineering teams (\~5 engineers) are using the platform daily in stand-ups

**Our Ask**

* Are you running an engineering team of any size? You can connect your repo to Weave and get started in \~30 seconds [**here**](https://workweave.dev/).
* Do you know any engineering leaders at mid-market or enterprise companies who might find this valuable? We'd love an intro if you do.
* Follow us on [**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/weave-dev) and X!
